title: Santé lattice cell schema v1.1
sources: CLAUDE → GROK — CONTINUITÉ — passage 26 — 1_AggmzUVa6Oxa5oNuYSLmoIQvQIPNKXHES1Kud-WKz0 (value-age, provisional if weight coverage <50%)
rules: Nothing is derived or invented. Unmappable columns or rows are reported as OPEN/unmapped, never guessed.
Country → zone is taken only from the lattice assignment (schema/country-zone.csv, extracted from lattice.json). Unknown countries stay unmapped; zone is not guessed.

Income quintiles stay Q1–Q5 (or ALL). They are population slices and are NEVER mapped onto the Manifestation zones Ω φ⁻ Σ φ⁺ α (20/40/60/80). Those protocol zones apply only to normalized attribute values inside the frozen engine.
City labels and definitions are kept as the source published them (place, greater city, built-up area, WUP city, …) and are never merged.
Ethnic-group labels are kept verbatim from the source. No cross-country harmonisation.
Age bands are the source bounds, verbatim. They are not rewritten into ALL/0-14/15-64/65+ unless the source already uses those exact labels.
No derived cross (e.g. city × ethnic) if the source does not publish it; the cell stays OPEN.
Provisional is true only when a numeric weight_coverage is present and is < 50. If coverage is unknown, provisional is left empty.
value_age is the whole number of calendar years between period_year and read_date when both are known; otherwise empty.
v1.1: Geographic chain is zone → country → region → city. A region cell carries region_code AND region_code_system; codes from different systems are never merged or cross-walked.
v1.1: Overlay indicators (VSL_*, BIGMAC_*) are country-level relative-value overlays. They are not split by sex, age or income quintile; those split cells are OPEN by definition.

v1.1: VSL values keep currency, price year and method verbatim. Values the source model-transferred (e.g. Viscusi & Masterman 2017 income-elasticity transfer) carry vsl_basis='source-modelled' and are never labelled national-official. No transfers are computed here.
v1.1: Big Mac euro-area entry (EUZ) is a single entity. Euro members carry it only with bigmac_scope='euro-area aggregate', never as a national value.

v1.1: POVERTY_* cells must carry poverty_line verbatim (e.g. '$3.00 a day (2021 PPP)', 'national line', '60% of national median', 'MBM 2018 base', 'US official threshold', 'global MPI k=33.3%'). Rates on different lines are never compared or averaged together.
v1.1: WORKFORCE_* cells carry occupation_code_system (WHO NHWA, ISCO-08, US SOC 2018) verbatim; ISCO 26 is not a proxy for ISCO 261 lawyers.
v1.1: Zone aggregates are population-weighted; provisional=true when weight coverage <50%.

cell_key.name: zone
cell_key.description: One of the six lattice zones: Africa, Europe, East, Middle East, South Pacific, America. Filled only via country-zone.csv / lattice assignment.

cell_key.name: country_iso3
cell_key.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, as in the lattice. Empty if the source country cannot be matched.

cell_key.name: country_name
cell_key.description: Lattice name when iso3 is known; otherwise the source label, unmapped.

cell_key.name: region_code
cell_key.description: Region code as published (e.g. NUTS2 FR10, US state FIPS 06, Canada SGC 35, OPHI survey region label slug). Empty for country-level cells.

cell_key.name: region_code_system
enum: OPHI/DHS-MICS survey subnational region (no standard code)
cell_key.description: System of region_code. Mandatory when region_code is set.

cell_key.name: region_label_verbatim
cell_key.description: Region name exactly as in the source.

cell_key.name: geo_level
cell_key.description: Level of the cell in the lattice chain.

cell_key.name: city_source_code
cell_key.description: City code as published by the source (e.g. WUP code, ONS built-up area code, US place code).

cell_key.name: city_definition
cell_key.description: Source definition of the city unit (place, city, greater city, built-up area, WUP urban agglomeration, …). Never fused across definitions.

cell_key.name: city_label_verbatim
cell_key.description: City name exactly as in the source.

cell_key.name: ethnic_group_source_label
cell_key.description: Ethnic/population-group label exactly as published. Empty if the source has none.

cell_key.name: sex
cell_key.description: T/M/F only when the source clearly says total/male/female (or equivalent). Otherwise unmapped.

cell_key.name: age_band_source
cell_key.description: Age band as the source wrote it (bounds or label), verbatim.

cell_key.name: income_quintile
cell_key.description: ALL or Q1–Q5 only when clearly labelled. Never inferred from a value, and never mapped to Ω…α.

value_fields.name: value
value_fields.description: Numeric value from the source. Empty when status is OPEN.

value_fields.name: unit
value_fields.description: Unit from the source or, when the indicator_code is a known lattice indicator, the unit already recorded for that code. Never invented.

value_fields.name: indicator_code
value_fields.description: Lattice indicator code (LE0, POP, …) only when the source column/code matches a known indicator. Otherwise empty and listed unmapped.

value_fields.name: indicator_label
value_fields.description: Source or lattice label for the indicator.

value_fields.name: period_year
value_fields.description: Period or year as stated by the source (may be a range).

value_fields.name: url
value_fields.description: URL if the source provides one.

value_fields.name: read_date
value_fields.description: Date the deposited file was read (ISO date).

value_fields.name: value_age
value_fields.description: Calendar years between period_year and read_date when both are known.

value_fields.name: weight_coverage
value_fields.description: Population-weight coverage in percent, only if the source or a lattice aggregate provides it.

value_fields.name: provisional
value_fields.description: true when weight_coverage is present and < 50; false when ≥ 50; empty when coverage is unknown.

value_fields.name: status
value_fields.description: FILLED if a value is present and the cell key is usable; otherwise OPEN.

value_fields.name: quality_note
value_fields.description: Quality note copied from the source when present (e.g. official statistics in development).

value_fields.name: unmapped_fields
value_fields.description: Semicolon-separated list of source columns or key parts that could not be mapped.

value_fields.name: row_disposition
value_fields.description: unmapped when the row cannot form a usable cell; it is still recorded, never dropped in silence.

quintiles_and_protocol: Q1–Q5 are income (or wealth) slices of a population. Ω φ⁻ Σ φ⁺ α are the engine's five zones on a normalized attribute, at 20/40/60/80 of the [−1,+1] axis (zoneOf). The door and the lattice must not superimpose them.

value_fields_v1_1_added.name: overlay
value_fields_v1_1_added.description: True for relative-value overlays (VSL_*, BIGMAC_*), which are never sex/age/quintile split.

value_fields_v1_1_added.name: currency_price_year_verbatim
value_fields_v1_1_added.description: Currency and price year as published (e.g. "USD million (2015 dollars)", "£ 2023 prices and 2023 values").

value_fields_v1_1_added.name: poverty_line
value_fields_v1_1_added.description: Exact poverty line used, verbatim. Required for POVERTY_*.
